pull.title: BIP-352: add test vectors for skipped inputs and label edge cases
pull.body:
This adds five test vectors for BIP352 cases the file does not cover; the changelog entry names them. reference.py computes every expected value and passes on the whole file, and btclib-wallet, which I maintain, agrees on all five ([run](https://gist.github.com/fametrano/6fb7bb91c50fe1bad04a6494c25f844d/3b4d7cf0a99aae1ee6d4bd66cc121786fd0a8aac)). The version is 1.1.4 because #2323 takes 1.1.3; I will rebase whichever lands second.

Under the scope #2339 set, I removed three cases that cannot be consensus-valid: a P2PKH input whose pubkey hash matches 33 bytes that are not a valid key, a P2TR input with an empty witness, and a P2TR input whose output key is not on the curve. reference.py keeps code for all three, and no vector reaches it now.

labels.name: Pending acceptance
labels.description: This BIP modification requires sign-off by the champion of the BIP being modified

events.body:
ACK d85c71c574d263eaf2c5c0ecd0f8a3ab07985243

Tested against reference.py and all 34 vectors pass.

Removing the three consensus-invalid cases is correct: an empty witness on P2TR, an off-curve output key, and an unspendable P2PKH hash cannot be mined into valid blocks, so a wallet scanner will never encounter them in confirmed transactions.

Vector 33 reuses the placeholder scriptSig on a1075db5 which lacks the sighash byte. Rebasing on #2348 once it lands will clean up that encoding across the new vectors too.

BIP-352: add test vectors for skipped inputs and label edge cases

Five send and receive vectors for cases the file does not cover yet:
- inputs of ineligible types (P2WSH, P2MS, P2PK, empty scriptPubKey)
  beside an eligible one;
- a P2SH-P2WSH input beside an eligible one, which is skipped;
- a P2TR script path spend whose internal key is not NUMS, which counts;
- the largest label, 0xFFFFFFFF;
- two recipients, one with a labeled address listed after the other
  recipient, with a taproot and a non-taproot input.

The P2WSH and P2SH-P2WSH witness script is also a valid compressed key,
so an implementation that reads the last witness item as a key fails.

reference.py computed the expected values and passes on the whole file.

events.body: Rebased on #2348 and appended SIGHASH_ALL to the 15 ECDSA signatures in the new vectors that lacked it, as #2348 did; the P2PKH scriptSigs now match the file's own. Expected values are unchanged.
Test-only changes but prefer to ask BIP authors @theStack @josibake @RubenSomsen for sign-off.
